prompt:
FANTASY MASTER REFERENCE FIRST: @Video1 is the master reference for the style, mood and characters of this whole clip. Match its render look, materials, colour palette, lighting mood, atmosphere, character design, proportions and animation feel on every frame; do not copy its exact shots, camera or story.

[Generation Goal] 20 seconds, 7 shots with hard cuts, 16:9, real-time 24 fps, no slow motion. The happy ending with EXACTLY 11 people and 1 puppy. Coverage is cut into SMALL GROUPS: no readable shot ever shows more than 4 people, and nobody ever appears twice. In the colossal dark BOSS arena (no villains), Mom kneels hugging Mai with Dad beside them and the puppy at Mai's feet; two groups of 4 friends stand on either side, watching. A ring of warm golden-pink light then transforms the arena into a joyful, dreamy PINK fantasy paradise, and the camera rises to a soft pink sky and holds on an open, clean sky (a title will be added in post-production).

[Arena Scale] The BOSS arena is COLOSSAL: a vast open plaza hundreds of metres across, enclosed by skyscraper-tall cliffs of stacked monitors that recede for hundreds of metres into cyan-teal fog, an open dark sky above (no ceiling). @Image1 shows only ONE view of this huge space: keep its materials, but the space always continues far beyond it; every group shot shows the monitor towers receding into deep haze behind the people. Never a small room, corridor or low ceiling.

[References] @Video1: style, mood and world only (not camera, not costumes). @Image1: one high view of the BOSS arena, ONLY for materials and design, not for camera angle or scale. Each following image is ONE separate person or object; copy each design exactly and keep every detail with its owner:
@Image2 = MAI ONLY: girl about 11, slim, fair skin, chin-length straight black BOB with full bangs, a small yellow hair clip on her left side; white short-sleeve school shirt with a navy sailor-style collar and navy sleeve cuffs, a red neckerchief tied at the collar; navy pleated knee-length skirt; white socks, white sneakers; light sky-blue backpack with a small yellow star charm. Unique: bob with bangs + sky-blue backpack.
@Image3 = MOM ONLY (the mother character of THIS project, an original design, not based on any existing film or cartoon character): woman about 40, kind face, hair in a low bun under a WHITE open-face motorbike helmet; a pale-YELLOW checked cape tied at her neck; a green apron with one white daisy over a white T-shirt; black wide-leg trousers; brown loafers; holds an ordinary black kitchen pan with a pink handle (NOT in this clip: her hands are free). Unique: white helmet + yellow checked cape + green daisy apron.
@Image4 = DAD ONLY: man about 45, short dark hair with grey streaks, rectangular dark-framed glasses, gentle smile; white crew-neck T-shirt under a chest-armour vest made of horizontal GREEN BAMBOO slats tied with brown cord, matching bamboo wrist guards; a wristwatch; dark navy trousers; brown leather sandals; bare hands, no gloves, no weapon. Unique: green bamboo-slat armour vest + glasses.
@Image5 = PUPPY ONLY: one small fluffy BLACK-AND-TAN puppy (tan muzzle, tan eyebrow spots, tan chest and paws), floppy ears, curled tail, happy. Exactly one dog.
@Image6 = TEACHER ONLY: young woman about 25, delicate pretty face, rosy cheeks, long black hair in a low ponytail with a soft side fringe, no glasses; a long PINK áo dài with a mandarin collar over wide white silk trousers; white flat shoes; no ruler in this clip. Unique: pink áo dài.
@Image7 = CLEANER ONLY: woman about 40, warm face, hair in a low bun, a straw CONICAL HAT (nón lá) with a thin purple chin strap; long-sleeve ORANGE work jacket and orange cargo trousers with lime-yellow reflective stripes on the chest, sleeves and legs; black work shoes; her bamboo broom held upright at her side. Unique: conical hat + orange hi-vis uniform.
@Image8 = DOCTOR ONLY: man about 60, neat salt-and-pepper grey hair, thin wire glasses, a light-blue surgical face mask; long WHITE lab coat over a light-blue shirt and dark navy tie; a black stethoscope around his neck; grey trousers, black shoes. Unique: white lab coat + grey hair + mask.
@Image9 = POLICE OFFICER ONLY: young man about 25, serious handsome face, short black hair; a dark-green PEAKED CAP with a small plain round cap badge, a thin gold cord and a black visor; a light olive-green SHORT-sleeve uniform shirt with bright RED collar tabs and RED shoulder boards, two chest pockets, gold buttons; a black belt with a gold buckle; DARK olive, almost black, trousers; black shoes; no weapon; badges unreadable. Unique: peaked cap + red collar tabs and shoulder boards + very dark trousers.
@Image10 = SECURITY GUARD ONLY: man about 50, round friendly face with smile lines, black hair with grey streaks parted to the side, clean-shaven, NO hat; an olive-khaki SHORT-sleeve shirt with shoulder straps and two chest flap pockets; a green SHIELD patch with a yellow border on his LEFT sleeve; matching olive-khaki trousers; black shoes; bare-handed (no baton). Unique: bare head + short sleeves + green shield patch.
@Image11 = ENGINEER ONLY: young man about 28, slim, round black glasses, short black hair under a bright YELLOW hard hat; white long-sleeve shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a pen in the pocket; grey trousers, brown belt, brown shoes. Unique: yellow hard hat.
@Image12 = BUS DRIVER ONLY: man about 35, big ears, black MOUSTACHE and small goatee; a light-blue baseball cap with a round badge; a light-blue LONG-sleeve uniform shirt with shoulder straps, a pen and a clipped ID card in the pocket; dark navy trousers, black belt, black shoes. Unique: light-blue cap + moustache.
@Image13 = SOLDIER ONLY: man about 38, lean, serious calm face; a green PITH HELMET with a small plain round badge and a chin strap; a green-brown-black CAMOUFLAGE long-sleeve jacket with four flap pockets, plain yellow shoulder boards and plain red collar tabs; camouflage cargo trousers tucked into tall green combat boots. Unique: camouflage + pith helmet.
@Image14 = THE BUS ONLY: one compact GREEN minibus with a lighter green stripe along the sides, rounded friendly front, one folding front door, a large windscreen, round headlights; no text or numbers anywhere.

[Head Count] EXACTLY 11 people in the whole scene, never more, never fewer, plus exactly 1 puppy; nobody else exists in this clip: no background crowd, no extra people, no twins or look-alikes; each person appears ONCE per frame.
1. Mai (@Image2): the family, centre.
2. Mom (@Image3): the family, centre.
3. Dad (@Image4): the family, centre.
4. The Police Officer (@Image9): group A (WEST of the family), position 1 from the left.
5. The Teacher (@Image6): group A, position 2.
6. The Cleaner (@Image7): group A, position 3.
7. The Doctor (@Image8): group A, position 4 (closest to the family).
8. The Engineer (@Image11): group B (EAST of the family), position 1 from the left (closest to the family).
9. The bus driver (@Image12): group B, position 2.
10. The Soldier (@Image13): group B, position 3.
11. The Security Guard (@Image10): group B, position 4 (far right end).
Plus: 1 puppy (@Image5) at Mai's feet. 1 parked green bus (@Image14), far NORTH in the haze, only in shots 1-5.

[No Blending] Every character is a SEPARATE person who keeps ONLY the costume, colours, hair, face and props of their own reference image. Never mix or swap clothing, hats, helmets, hair or props; never merge two characters. Only the Soldier (@Image13) wears camouflage and a pith helmet; only the Police Officer (@Image9) wears a peaked cap; only the Engineer (@Image11) wears a hard hat; only the Cleaner (@Image7) wears a conical hat; only the bus driver (@Image12) wears a light-blue cap; only Mom (@Image3) wears a white helmet and the yellow checked cape; only Dad (@Image4) wears the green bamboo-slat vest; only the Teacher (@Image6) wears an áo dài; only the Doctor (@Image8) wears a white coat. The Police Officer (@Image9, young, peaked cap, red collar tabs, very dark trousers) and the Security Guard (@Image10, about 50, bare grey-streaked head, green shield patch, khaki trousers) are different men and stand at opposite ends of the scene.

[Space & Blocking — fixed scene map, identical in every shot] The family is at the centre of the floor: Mom (@Image3) kneeling, hugging Mai (@Image2); Dad (@Image4) standing at Mom's right; the puppy (@Image5) at Mai's feet. Group A stands in a short curved line a few metres to the WEST (screen LEFT of the family), facing EAST toward the family, so in their shot they look toward screen RIGHT. Group B stands a few metres to the EAST (screen RIGHT of the family), facing WEST, so in their shot they look toward screen LEFT. The camera always stays on the SOUTH side of the scene. The bus is parked far to the NORTH, behind the family. Same moment, same light and same positions in every shot; people never move between groups. Do not mirror the scene.

[Action & Camera, time-ordered] One dominant camera move per shot; no extreme face close-ups.
Shot 1 (0-3 s), the family, 3 people visible (Mom, Mai, Dad) + the puppy: MEDIUM shot at Mai's (@Image2) eye level from the south, 35 mm, ONE slow arc from left to right: in the cold blue-violet arena Mom (@Image3) kneels and hugs Mai (@Image2) tightly, Mai's face buried in her mother's shoulder; Dad (@Image4) lowers one hand onto both their shoulders; the puppy (@Image5) sits against Mai's feet, wagging its tail; far behind them the parked bus (@Image14) glows in the haze. Cut.
Shot 2 (3-4 s), insert, no faces, only Mom's hand, Mai's backpack strap and the puppy in frame: waist-height insert, 50-65 mm, slight push-in: Mom's (@Image3) hand gently squeezes the strap of Mai's (@Image2) sky-blue backpack; the puppy (@Image5) nuzzles Mai's white sneaker. Cut.
Shot 3 (4-6.5 s), group A watches, 4 people visible: the Police Officer (@Image9), the Teacher (@Image6), the Cleaner (@Image7), the Doctor (@Image8), left to right: MEDIUM-WIDE from the south-west, 35 mm, ONE slow push-in: the four stand in a short curved line, looking toward screen RIGHT at the family (off-screen), smiling softly at different moments; the Teacher presses a hand to her chest, the Cleaner leans on her broom, the Doctor gives a small nod; the monitor towers recede far into the fog behind them. Cut.
Shot 4 (6.5-9 s), group B watches, 4 people visible: the Engineer (@Image11), the bus driver (@Image12), the Soldier (@Image13), the Security Guard (@Image10), left to right: MEDIUM-WIDE from the south-east, 35 mm, ONE slow push-in: the four stand in a short curved line looking toward screen LEFT at the family (off-screen), each smiling on their own timing; the bus driver takes off his cap, the Soldier stands relaxed, the Security Guard folds his hands; the monitor towers recede far into the fog behind them. Cut.
Shot 5 (9-11.5 s), she looks up, 3 people visible (Mom, Mai, Dad) + the puppy: MEDIUM, slightly low three-quarter front angle, 50 mm, ONE gentle push-in: Mai (@Image2) slowly lifts her head from Mom's (@Image3) shoulder, glances toward screen LEFT (group A), then toward screen RIGHT (group B), and gives a small, shy smile; Dad (@Image4) smiles down at her. Cut.
Shot 6 (11.5-15.5 s), transformation, 3 people visible (the family, small, from behind) + the puppy; both groups stay out of frame: WIDE, camera low at floor level behind the family, 20-24 mm, ONE slow rise (pedestal up): right in front of the lens the dark wet floor cracks and soft green grass with pink, white and peach flowers blooms; a ring of warm golden-pink light spreads outward from the family; wherever it passes, the monitor walls, the parked bus and every dark object dissolve into sparkling smoke that bursts into pink and white petals, glowing butterflies and tiny floating lights; the dark sky dome opens onto a glowing pastel-pink and peach sky; a breeze lifts Mom's yellow cape and Mai's red neckerchief; Mai gives one small happy hop and the puppy chases a petal. Cut.
Shot 7 (15.5-20 s), the pink paradise, 11 people visible only as tiny distant silhouettes (family in the middle, group A on the left, group B on the right), each exactly once + the puppy: ULTRA-WIDE extreme establishing shot, 14-18 mm, ONE slow crane up that ends tilted toward the sky, then the camera STOPS and holds perfectly still from 17 s to 20 s: a joyful, dreamy pastel-PINK fantasy paradise of rolling green hills covered with pink, white and peach flowers, round trees in full pink blossom, a sparkling stream, glowing lanterns and dandelion lights rising slowly; the group is tiny in the lower third, no faces readable; NO bus and no vehicles anywhere; pink petals drift up; the soft pink-and-peach sky with fluffy pink-gold clouds fills the upper two-thirds, open and clean, with nothing written in it.

[Acting] Quiet, deep relief and love in shots 1-5: Mom holds Mai as if she will never let go; Mai melts into the hug, then lifts her head slowly, teary but smiling; the friends watch with warm, gentle smiles, each reacting on their own timing, never in sync. Shots 6-7: joy blooms with light steps, one small hop and the puppy bouncing. Classic animation principles: eyes lead, then head, then body; anticipation before actions; follow-through on hair, capes and petals; real weight; reactions a beat after their trigger.

[Character Look] Skin tone exactly as in each character reference: fair, light, warm-ivory skin with a soft healthy blush on the cheeks. Coloured scene light (cyan, teal, gold) only tints the skin softly on the lit side and in the rim; it never darkens, greys or browns the overall skin tone. Faces stay bright and readable, with a gentle fill on the faces even in dark shots. Every character keeps exactly the costume, hair and props of their reference image, exactly ONE of each named character.
[Expression] Subtle, restrained, natural expressions at about a third to half of full intensity, like a premium feature film, not a cartoon or meme face: small changes in the brows, eyelids and the corners of the mouth carry the emotion; mouths mostly closed or only slightly parted, opening wider only for a single breath and closing again; eyes widen only slightly; no gurning, no exaggerated eyebrows, no wide-open screaming mouth, no bulging eyes, no rubbery stretching face. Genuine, gentle smiles, not exaggerated grins.

[Lighting] Shots 1-5: the same cold blue-violet ambient light in every group shot, far walls fading into haze, a soft warm fill on faces so skin stays fair, rim light from the north. Shots 6-7: bright dreamy pastel palette of soft PINK, peach, cream and fresh green, golden-pink sunlight, sparkles, soft bloom, warm rim light; no cold tones left.

[Visual Style] Exactly the style of @Video1 (premium stylized 3D animated feature film, soft rounded volumes, matte materials, fine film grain, slight bloom), turning to a bright, joyful, dreamy pastel-pink fantasy palette in shots 6-7. Children 6-6.5 heads tall, adults 7-7.5, not chibi. 16:9, real-time 24 fps.

[Audio] Sound effects and ambience only: soft breathing and fabric in the hug, the puppy's gentle whimper, a vast airy room tone, a rising shimmer of golden light, petals and leaves rustling, grass growing softly, the sky dome opening with a soft airy sound, a warm breeze, cheerful birdsong, soft wind chimes, magical tinkles, soft laughter, the puppy's happy yips. NO music, NO score, NO song, NO singing, NO melody, no dialogue.

[Avoid] more than 4 recognisable people in one shot, crowded frames, extreme face close-ups; a person appearing in the wrong group or in two groups; slow motion, speed ramp, freeze frame, fast-forward; any text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or readable badges; the same person twice in one frame, twins, clones, extra people, background crowd, more than 11 people, more than one puppy; characters blending together, swapped costumes, a hat or helmet on the wrong person, merged characters; a pan in Mom's hands; dark, tanned, grey or muddy skin; over-acting, gurning, wide open mouths; hoodie, chibi; mirrored layout, crossing the action line, eyelines pointing the wrong way; flat lighting, sterile plastic CG, pasted-on characters; sliding feet, morphing, extra fingers or limbs; robotic or floaty motion; small room, corridor, low ceiling, cramped space; the bus in shots 6-7, any moving vehicle, black smoke; gloomy, grey or cold colours in shots 6-7; purple or violet in the pink paradise; top-down framing in shots 1-5; any title, words or letters in the sky; villains, shadow figures or creatures; background music, score, singing; resemblance to any existing film, cartoon, game or comic character or brand; studio or film names.
